_comment: Lines a translation must carry VERBATIM from the English page, at the same line number. The wiki parses them as data: src/lib/parseMarkdown.ts reads the wallet fields by their English labels and colours the Ironwood badge by its English status, so a translated label or value blanks the field in that locale. Checked by scripts/check-verbatim-lines.mjs; `--fix` copies the English lines over.
